name: eval3d
definition: A gaussian evaluation method where each gaussian is evaluated by its peak response along the pixel's view ray, rather than by its projected 2D footprint. It is used to correctly render scenes trained with 3DGUT (NVIDIA 3dgrut, or gsplat with with_ut / with_eval3d), which are optimized for this evaluation metric.
summary: eval3d is a ray-based rendering method for 3D Gaussian particles that computes Gaussian response along view rays to fix visual degradation in 3DGUT scenes, unlike standard EWA splatting.
